    <style>
      #quarto-content, main.content { margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: none; }

      #ribasim-viewer { height: calc(100vh - var(--viewer-offset, 0px)); padding: 0; }

```{=html}
<div id="ribasim-viewer"></div>
<script>
  // Size the viewer to the space below the navbar
  const header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--viewer-offset", `${header ? header.offsetHeight : 0}px`);
</script>
```
